x: Jarlett ran a splendid race to beat Holmes, with W.
Pettit, who is a City of London policeman, and although the latter ran well, he could not get on terms with Jarlett, who led throughout. Third place was taken by W.
Jarlett was a notable absentee from the 440 Yards, and we had to rely upon W.
Day, the T.V.H. runner, beat Wally Watts to win the 440 Yards with Thomas beating Ryan, of the Met.
Hoath, of the N.F.S., who is also a member of the "Bels." W.
Amongst those so honoured are Les Cohen, Charlie Smart, Stan Botwright, Len Marchant, Len Herbert, Tom Carter, Syd Jarlett, Charlie Melchoir, Wally Watts, T.
